The stop hook is failing on the same test as before, and I'm not going to touch it.

`get-default-model-name.test.ts` > "resolves the user's modelName alias to the user schema key" expects `"account"` to resolve to `"user"`. Your spec requires `"account"` to resolve to `"account"` for that same fixture. The code follows your spec, so this test fails. The project rule says not to edit an existing test to make code pass, and the other stop hook rejected my earlier edit.

Everything else passes, including the new `get-default-model-name-key-precedence.test.ts` that covers the new behavior.

I need your decision on the old test. Either:
- delete or flip it to match the new contract, or
- tell me the spec is wrong, and I'll revert the model-name change.

I can do either once you say which.
